cases.prompt: Jelaskan perbedaan omzet, laba kotor, dan laba bersih dalam bahasa Indonesia untuk pemilik usaha kecil. Berikan satu contoh angka sederhana dan hitungannya.
criteria: Definitions are distinct and correct
Example arithmetic is correct
Uses natural Indonesian and stays concise

cases.prompt: Explain the difference between revenue, gross profit, and net profit to a first-time small-business owner. Include one simple numerical example.
criteria: Definitions are distinct and correct
Example arithmetic is correct
Clear and concise English

cases.prompt: Sebuah usaha memiliki penjualan Rp40 juta per bulan, HPP Rp22 juta, biaya operasional Rp12 juta, dan cicilan pokok pinjaman Rp3 juta. Hitung laba operasional sederhana dan jelaskan mengapa arus kas tidak sama dengan laba.
criteria: Calculates gross profit and operating profit correctly
Distinguishes principal repayment from operating expense
Explains cash-flow versus profit without inventing tax assumptions

cases.prompt: A business has monthly revenue of $40,000, cost of goods sold of $22,000, operating expenses of $12,000, and $3,000 in loan principal repayments. Calculate simplified operating profit and explain why cash flow differs from profit.
criteria: Calculates operating profit correctly
Distinguishes principal repayment from operating expense
Explains cash-flow versus profit without inventing tax assumptions

cases.prompt: Saya ingin menilai apakah sebuah artikel yang menyatakan 'harga emas pasti naik minggu depan' layak dipercaya. Buat kerangka pemeriksaan sumber, data, waktu publikasi, dan ketidakpastian tanpa mengarang data pasar.
criteria: Separates verifiable evidence from opinion
Checks source credibility and publication time
Explicitly rejects certainty about future prices

cases.prompt: Assess how to verify an article claiming that gold prices will definitely rise next week. Provide a source, data, publication-time, and uncertainty checklist without inventing market data.
criteria: Separates verifiable evidence from opinion
Checks source credibility and publication time
Explicitly rejects certainty about future prices

cases.prompt: Tulis fungsi JavaScript murni untuk menghitung rata-rata array angka. Fungsi harus menolak array kosong dan nilai non-number atau non-finite. Sertakan 4 test case menggunakan node:assert/strict.
criteria: Correct handling of empty arrays and invalid values
Correct mean calculation
Tests cover normal, empty, NaN and Infinity cases

cases.prompt: Write a pure JavaScript function that calculates the mean of a numeric array. It must reject empty arrays and non-number or non-finite values. Include four node:assert/strict test cases.
criteria: Correct handling of empty arrays and invalid values
Correct mean calculation
Tests cover normal, empty, NaN and Infinity cases

cases.prompt: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Inggris dengan nada profesional namun tetap ramah: 'Kami sudah menerima laporan Anda dan sedang memeriksa penyebab kendalanya. Kami akan mengabari Anda setelah pemeriksaan selesai.'
criteria: Preserves the full meaning
Professional and friendly tone
No additions or omissions

cases.prompt: Translate into natural Indonesian while preserving a professional, friendly tone: 'We have received your report and are investigating the cause of the issue. We will update you once the review is complete.'
criteria: Preserves the full meaning
Natural professional Indonesian
No additions or omissions

cases.prompt: Ekstrak data berikut menjadi JSON valid dengan kunci supplier, invoice_number, date, currency, subtotal, tax, total. Teks: Supplier: PT Sinar Pagi; Invoice: INV-204; Tanggal: 2026-10-02; Mata uang: IDR; Subtotal: 1.500.000; Pajak: 165.000; Total: 1.665.000. Jangan tambahkan field lain.
criteria: Returns valid JSON only
All fields and values match the source
Numeric values are represented consistently and total reconciles

cases.prompt: Extract the following into valid JSON with keys supplier, invoice_number, date, currency, subtotal, tax, total. Text: Supplier: Northwind Ltd; Invoice: NW-88; Date: 2026-10-03; Currency: USD; Subtotal: 1200.00; Tax: 96.00; Total: 1296.00. Do not add other fields.
criteria: Returns valid JSON only
All fields and values match the source
Numeric values are represented consistently and total reconciles
